items.raw_excerpt: Home buyers in the Netherlands had more choice and, in some cases, more room to negotiate over the summer, but the market remains tight, according to estate agents’ association NVM. items.summary_en: Home buyers in the Netherlands had more choice and more room to negotiate over summer, but the market remains tight. About two-thirds of homes sold went for more than the asking price, down from 71% a year earlier. More supply is giving buyers a bit more breathing space, according to estate agents' association NVM.
